title: Re-Issue of Lapsed Network Equipment and Server & Storage Build Quotes
content:
**Scope.** This Hardware Procurement rule prices the re-issue of a client's Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote that has passed the last day of its validity period unsigned. The re-issue keeps the quote's number, part, quantity and distributor unit cost, re-prices the unit and re-dates the quote to the re-issue day so that a new validity period starts, and replaces its unit price and total. Only such a re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote is priced here.

**What the re-issue rule governs, and what it leaves.** For a re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote, and only for such a re-issue, the unit is re-priced on the re-issue day and the quote total is figured under this re-issue schedule. A staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line follows the staged re-quote schedule, and every other quote's unit price stays the distributor unit cost times one plus the effective markup, rounded half up to the cent, the effective markup being the markup percentage reduced by the ClearPath markup reduction when on the quote date the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least the lowest earning rank; every other quote's total stays the quantity times the unit price, plus the staging fee per unit times the quantity, plus the handling fee, plus the rush fee when rush is requested where rush processing is available.

## Invocation: `reissue_lapsed_quote_93c9a091`

**Capability.** Re-issues a client's unsigned hardware quote whose validity period has ended. One call keeps the quote's number, units and distributor unit cost and its quoted status, re-dates it to today so a new validity period starts, and replaces its unit price and quote total with the values passed in. The client sees the quote re-issued with today's date, the new unit price and the new total, ready to sign.

**How it is invoked.** `reissue_lapsed_quote_93c9a091` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters**

1. `hardware_order_id`: reference number of the quoted hardware order being re-issued, as returned by the hardware order lookup for this client; an identifier.
2. `unit_price_usd`: the re-issued sell price per unit in USD, rounded half up to 2 decimal places.
3. `quote_total_usd`: the re-issued quote total in USD, rounded half up to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the quote number (HQ- followed by 6 digits), the order reference, its new quote date (YYYY-MM-DD), its re-issued unit price and its re-issued quote total, both in USD with 2 decimal places; receiving it means the re-issue is on record.
